author: Inside Edition
description: Police say 33-year-old Dallas Pokornik is a real-life "Catch Me If You Can" scammer, posing as a pilot to score free flights. His only professional aviation experience, according to US authorities, is that he used to be a flight attendant. Pokornik allegedly traveled the world in his pose as a pilot. Prosecutors say as a fake pilot, Pokornik obtained hundreds of free flights over the course of four years. Pokornik is facing federal wire fraud charges. He has pleaded not guilty.
title: Man Posed As Pilot To Score Free Flights, Police Say

author: Inside Edition
description: A daredevil is about to climb a 101-story skyscraper, the 11th tallest building in the world. It is a free solo climb, meaning the climber will not use ropes, harnesses or safety nets. The live Netflix event will air Friday night. Alex Honnold understands the risks, but says his 30 years of training is his safety net. Honnold previously captured the world in the Oscar-winning documentary "Free Solo" where he successfully climbed the sheer face of El Capitan in Yosemite National Park.
title: Climber Alex Honnold To Climb 101-Story Skyscraper In Live Event

author: Inside Edition
description: Doorbell camera captures a carjacker taking off in a black Kia with a child still in the back seat. The boy's mom ran down the street pleading for help. Later, police in Colorado Springs found the boy unharmed in his car seat in the abandoned SUV. Two-year-old Giovanni asked "Where's my mom?" Police used a technology called advanced license plate recognition or ALPR to track the vehicle's movements.
title: Missing 2-Year-Old Found In Abandoned Stolen SUV

author: Inside Edition
description: As the United States braces for the monster snow storm barreling across the nation, many are panic-buying essentials. Experts say the smart thing to do is only buy enough food and water for 72 hours. They advise against buying too many perishables, and say stock up on canned and packaged food, and to test flashlights and radios before the storm hits. The storm could stretch 2,000 miles and impact 200 million people. Twenty-two states have declared a state of emergency.
title: Tips On Preparing For Winter Storm

author: Inside Edition
description: The Trump administration is once again taking aim at late night and liberal-leaning talk shows like "The View." Under new guidance released by the FCC, the talk shows are being told that if they invite a candidate for political office on the show, they must offer the same opportunity to their opponent. Experts say the new order targets the hosts whose jokes the president hates. Meanwhile, President Donald Trump's tough talk in Switzerland is sparking friction with European allies.
title: New FCC Guidance Targets Late Night And Talk Shows

author: Inside Edition
description: The M.V. Salem Express ferry was traveling from Saudi Arabia to Egypt in 1991, when it sank to the bottom of the Red Sea. While some 180 passengers survived, 470 people did not. The bodies of those who perished have been removed, and now the remains of the Salem Express serve as a popular – if controversial – site for divers. Thirty-five years after the disaster, several features of the boat are still recognizable, and serve as a draw for underwater photographers.
title: Old Suitcases Still Visible In Remains Of Ferry Disaster

author: Inside Edition
description: With temperatures plummeting across the USA, INSIDE EDITION traveled to the University of Wisconsin in Madison to see if college students were taking the extreme winter weather seriously. During the day, students on campus were bundled up in their warmest winter wear. But as the night heated up, the snow started to fall, and the temperature dropped to a bone-chilling 16 degrees. But that didn't stop some college students from shedding their bulky winter coats and hitting the town in style.
title: Students Ditch Winter Coats For Stylish Outfits In Freezing Temps

author: Inside Edition
description: Wade Wilson, who has dozens of tattoos on his face, became known as the "Deadpool Killer," because he shared a name with the Marvel character.
title: Who Was The "Deadpool Killer?" #shorts

author: Inside Edition
description: Three years ago, Angela Maples became ill and learned she was in complete kidney failure. She was on dialysis while awaiting a kidney transplant. Doctors told her her best option was to find a living donor. Maples realized she was running out of time. She tells Inside Edition she called her husband Joshua's ex-wife Amanda McCowen. McCowen said she'd submitted her application and turned out she was a match. Maples and McCowen underwent a successful transplant.
title: Woman Donates Her Kidney To Her Ex-Husband's Wife

author: Inside Edition
description: A child is reportedly in critical condition, and his mother's boyfriend under arrest, after police were called to a home and found the child unresponsive. The North Miami Beach Police released this bodycam of the responding officer trying to revive the 6-year-old boy. Reports say the child was taken to the hospital where he remains unconscious and in intensive care since January 9. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 6-Year-Old Boy Unresponsive In ICU, Mom's Boyfriend Arrested For Abuse: Reports
